items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Jimmy Lyons... and the then- musical director Mundell Lowe got the idea to put music education in Monterey County... So they started with three clinicians: myself, Bill Berry

ctx.x: I do lots of things too you know.

Well I mean you asked me about doing other things, and I’ve sort of avoided the teaching per se. I mean I give an occasional lesson but I don’t have a stable of students or a place. But I am involved and I have been since its inception for twenty years now, in the Monterey Jazz Festival has a jazz educational program that was started oh around ’83 I guess or ’84. Jimmy Lyons, who ran the festival for so many years, he and the then- musical director Mundell Lowe got the idea to put music education in Monterey…
